Package org.apache.wiki.auth

Class AccountLifecycleMailer

java.lang.Object
org.apache.wiki.auth.AccountLifecycleMailer
All Implemented Interfaces:
AccountLifecycle.Notifier
public final class AccountLifecycleMailer extends Object implements AccountLifecycle.Notifier
Tells the owners of the accounts by e-mail what AccountLifecycle does to them. The texts are the notification.credentials.* ones of the templates bundle. Nobody is told who has no e-mail address.
Since:
3.0.1
